title: Fixed Prepositions — Verb, Adjective & Noun Combinations
topicTitle: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
description: Verb, Adjective aur Noun ke sath aane wale high-frequency fixed prepositions, confusing preposition pairs (agree with/to, apply to/for, result in/from), transitive direct-object verbs (zero preposition), preposition + gerund (-ing) constructions, aur High Court administrative/legal collocations ko master karein.
learningObjectives: Common verb + preposition combinations ko accurately recognize aur apply karein
Common adjective + preposition combinations ko context ke hisaab se select karein
Common noun + preposition combinations ke natural sentence structures ko decode karein
Intended expression aur context ke anusaar accurate preposition select karein
Similar meaning wale confusing preposition combinations (agree with vs agree to, apply to vs apply for) mein farq karein
Direct object verbs ko identify karein jahan standard English mein extra preposition lagana strictly prohibited hota hai
Unnecessary, missing, ya incorrect prepositions se hone wale exam errors ko eliminate karein
High Court exams mein aane wale recurring administrative aur legal vocabulary combinations ko master karein
Random lists ratne ke bajaye clear grammatical reasoning aur collocation patterns se questions solve karein
Preposition followed by -ing (gerund) vs infinitive (to + V1) ke structural distinction ko accurately implement karein

included: Core Verb + Preposition collocations: depend on, rely on, insist on, approve of, accuse of, blame for, comply with, deal with, refer to, belong to, apply for/to, suffer from, recover from, prevent from, object to, prefer to, confide in, believe in, consist of, result in/from, agree with/to

Core Adjective + Preposition collocations: interested in, afraid of, aware of, responsible for, capable of, similar to, different from, famous for, good at/for, bad at, satisfied with, pleased with, concerned about, eligible for, accustomed to, prone to, consistent with, devoid of, liable for/to, senior/junior to

Core Noun + Preposition collocations: reason for, cause of, access to, demand for, need for, advantage of, interest in, relationship with, solution to, effect on, influence on, increase/decrease in, awareness of, responsibility for, exception to

Confusing Preposition Pairs: agree with vs to, apply to vs for, accuse of vs blame for, result in vs from, compare with vs to, complain of vs about, good at vs for, angry with vs about, prefer X to Y, senior/junior to
Direct-Object Verbs taking zero preposition: discuss, enter (physical room), reach, order, resemble, approach, emphasize
Prepositions followed by Gerunds (-ing): object to doing, accustomed to doing, look forward to doing, prevent from doing, insist on completing
Administrative and Legal Fixed Prepositions: abide by, adhere to, acquit of, convict of, vested in/with, charged with, in accordance with, pursuant to, dispose of, liable to/for, refrain/abstain from
excluded: Basic spatio-temporal In/On/At pyramids and physical movement vectors (covered in Lesson 11)
Articles and Quantifiers: A/An/The, Few/Little, Some/Any (covered in Lesson 10)
Subject-Verb Concord non-prepositional rules (covered in Lesson 13)
General Idiomatic Phrasal Verbs unrelated to fixed preposition questions (covered in Lesson 18)
